summary.en: Takagi and Miyamoto pose as a bride and groom in order to catch a serial killer/burglar who had threatened to kill the real bride and groom. When Chiba reports that the burned corpse of one of the weddings guests is found near the river, Megure deduces that the victim was killed by the serial killer in order to obtain the wedding invitation. A mysterious video arrives at the wedding party from a friend of the groom. After watching the video, Megure suspects that the killer is already in the chapel and Conan suggests that the bride should meet with the guests in order to find the burglar who broke into her house. The bride reports that there are three suspicious guests: a photographer named Rinzo Gunji, a snowboarding instructor named Teigo Shimabukuro, and an internet administrator named Fukuharu Karube. The groom insists that the wedding continues, despite Megure's protests. Multiple Robberies, Murders and Arson (Past) Location: Different households in Tokyo Time: Until six months ago Cause of death: Slit wound on the throats Suspects: Rinzo Gunji, Teigo Shimabukuro, and Fukuharu Karube Before attempting to rob Masudo's house, the masked burglar had claimed the lives of six people in four different houses before burning and taking all the loot. Robbery / Attempted Murder (Past) Location: Masudo household Victim: Rei Masudo and two elderly maids Age: 28 years old (Rei) Time: Six months ago Offense weapons: Kitchen knife Suspects: Rinzo Gunji, Teigo Shimabukuro, and Fukuharu Karube Six months ago, while she was sleeping, Rei had been attacked by a burglar who tried to slit her throat but was saved by Taira who had just camed by which made them wanting to marry. Location: Taira's apartment Victim: Masateru Taira Suspects: Rinzo Gunji, Teigo Shimabukuro, and Fukuharu Karube After the attempted murder at Rei's house, the masked man entered Masateru's apartment and checked his computer so he could infiltrate the marriage party. Location: Abandoned warehouse near the Teimuzu river Age: 30-40 years old Cause of death: Slit wound on the throat and burning Suspects: Rinzo Gunji, Teigo Shimabukuro, and Fukuharu Karube Chiba gets a call from the victim, leading him to an abandoned warehouse where he finds the burned victim.
